description: Behaviour probes for the LiangShen dispatcher discipline and working discipline. Each task ships a small deterministic simulator with an oracle (tools/probes/<id>/grade.mjs) and two scripted policies (strategies.mjs) that tools/probe-selftest.mjs uses to prove the probe discriminates before a model is charged for it. The pass/fail column is the oracle; the behaviour metrics beside it are the habit that produced the outcome, which is the measure that catches a session whose score is fine and whose process is not.

turns: This workspace holds a junction simulator. Run `node env.mjs help` for its commands and its rule, then drive all four of its cycles, admitting as many movements as the rule allows. Reply DONE when the run is complete.

This workspace holds a release scheduler. Run `node env.mjs help` for its commands and its rule, then work through its eight cycles, releasing as many jobs as the rule allows. Reply DONE when the run is complete.
This workspace holds an on-call board. Run `node env.mjs help` for its commands and its rule, then work through all ten of its steps. Reply DONE when the run is over.

This workspace holds a log search over twenty services, exactly one of which is faulty. Run `node env.mjs help` for its commands, find the faulty service and submit it before the call budget runs out. Reply DONE when you have submitted.
